arguments.sql:
WITH tall_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM main.Player
    WHERE height > 180
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tall_players) AS tall_player_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM tall_players) AS tall_player_api_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM main.Player_Attributes AS a
     WHERE a.player_api_id IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM tall_players)) AS attribute_rows,
    COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,
    COUNT(a.heading_accuracy) AS recorded_heading_scores,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(a.heading_accuracy) = 'integer' THEN 1 END) AS integer_heading_scores
FROM tall_players AS p
JOIN main.Player_Attributes AS a ON a.player_api_id = p.player_api_id;

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    p.player_api_id,
    p.player_name,
    AVG(a.heading_accuracy) AS mean_heading_accuracy
FROM main.Player AS p
JOIN main.Player_Attributes AS a
    ON a.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
  AND a.heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY mean_heading_accuracy DESC, p.player_api_id ASC
LIMIT 10
